`llada_generate.py` is the unmodified upstream `generate.py` from
https://github.com/ML-GSAI/LLaDA/commit/9182493720ed723ef8031210d85959364e51cbe0.
Authorship belongs to ML-GSAI/LLaDA contributors. The experiment calls its `generate`
function directly. The bootstrap compares it byte-for-byte with a pinned checkout.
The inspected upstream revision has no root LICENSE file; no license is invented here.
The Hugging Face model card separately declares MIT for the checkpoint.
